name: Sree Raswanth V S
about: Hi, I'm Sree Raswanth V S 👋
I'm from Chennai, India, currently looking for a Software Developer role💻
Most recently I worked at Amazon📦 as a Quality Service Associate
on Alexa Tech Support Team owning two major feature testing across
50+ Alexa devices and earning a Wall of Fame🌟 by Amazon mentioned for
delivering 100% production execution with zero missed defects.
I'm also a network-administration🔐 enthusiast, and I'm currently
learning cloud system design☁️ and artificial intelligence🤖.
Outside work, I'm passionate about device freedom: you paid💵 for your
phone📱, so you deserve its full potential. I teach people how to unlock
bootloaders, remove bloatware, install custom ROMs, and tweak system
performance📈 — and exactly what the trade-offs are when they do.
